title: Salvador Dalí on “What’s My Line.”
content: Salvador Dalí was the universal artist.In his own mind at least, he was performer, sports figure, leading man, humorist, comic artist, published author, and, oh yes, painter. This made him a tricky candidate for the old TV game show “What’s My Line?” where contestants tried to guess a person’s profession.Notice how he shrewdly sizes up the room at the outset, and then maintains a deadpan sprezzatura afterward.--------------ViaBest of YouTubePreviously:SprezzaturaDali on Wikipedia
